quiz.question: Your ideal Saturday afternoon:
quiz.subtext: Hmm… do you linger in a place steeped in memories, or bask in sunlight with a sparkling drink? Perhaps you seek a burst of energy or a little chaos?

options.label: A
options.text: Sitting outside in the sun with a sparkling drink
options.comment: Sunshine and spritzes – basically a walking Instagram story.

options.label: B
options.text: Reminiscing at a cozy café or bar you love
options.comment: Ah, the sentimental type. You cry over your first sip of espresso.

options.label: C
options.text: Playing video games, racing, or doing something spontaneous
options.comment: Chaos incarnate. You live life one kart crash at a time.

options.label: D
options.text: Getting energized with a strong coffee and tackling projects
options.comment: Buzzing like a caffeinated squirrel. Productivity is your middle name.

options.label: B

options.label: C

options.label: D
